column_description: VARCHAR(50). Location code for the return processing. PK. Example: LOC008.
VARCHAR(50). Processing priority for the return. Possible values: Bulk, Express, Standard.
ProcessingStatus_enum. Current state of the return processing. Possible values: Completed, Inspecting, Processing, Received.
REAL. Time taken for processing the return. Example: 15.0.
HandlingRequirements_enum. Handling requirements for the return. Possible values: Fragile, Hazardous, Special, Standard.
VARCHAR(20). Indicates if quarantine is needed for the return. Possible values: No, Yes.
BIGINT. Number of days the return item will be quarantined. Example: 14.
TEXT. Notes related to the handling of the return item.
TEXT. Disposition action for the return item. Possible values: Refurbish, Repair, Resell, Scrap.
DispositionReason_enum. Reason for the return disposition. **NULL means no disposition reason provided.**. Possible values: Good Condition, Repairable, Too Costly, Unsalvageable.
TEXT. Indicates if relabeling is required for the return item. Possible values: 0, 1, F, False, N, NO, P, True, Y, YES.
RepairFeasibility_enum. Feasibility of repairing the return item. Possible values: High, Low, Medium, Not Feasible.
REAL. Estimated hours required for repair. Example: 39.8.
PartsAvailability_enum. Availability of parts for repairing the return item. Possible values: Available, Partial, Unavailable.
TEXT. Policy compliance status of the return item. Possible values: Compliant, Non-compliant.
VARCHAR(20). Indicates if an exception was made for the return. Possible values: No, Yes.
ExceptionReason_enum. Type of exception for the return. **NULL means no exception type provided.**. Possible values: Customer Value, Error, Goodwill.
ApprovalLevel_enum. Level of approval required for processing the return. Possible values: Automatic, Manager, Supervisor.
